name: firm-objection-handling
description: Builds an objection handling map with one row per objection you actually hear, covering what to listen for, what is true in it, the question that finds the real concern, an honest response, the proof you hold or "none yet" and what you will not say. Use for "run firm-objection-handling", "prepare me for objections", "they said send me something", "we will do it in house", "the timing is not right", "how do I answer too expensive", "the same objections every time", part of the Claude for Consultants · Team in Claude Pack by 90n.
